story: Airlines inching closer to dynamic pricing
text: This video does a good job explaining how airline pricing works nowadays: [VIDEO] Basically, from the info they get, (destination, departure date, return date, etc.) they try to guess what kind of traveler the customer is and price the ticket accordingly. E.g. if there is no weekend between departure and return, they think that you must be a business traveler so the ticket is more expensive.

story: Boeing 747s are back in demand as workhorses of global shipping

story: Amazon Prime inflates prices, using the false promise of ‘free shipping’
text: US prime is marketed as "two day", though in many markets free next-day arrival is common. [LINK] is a pretty good Youtube video about Amazon's shipping system. [VIDEO] is a good Youtube video that discusses how overnight shipping systems like Fedex etc. have works.
